يستقطعوا (form X)
# يَسْتَقْطِعُوا (yastaqṭiʕū) /jas.taq.tˤi.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# يُسْتَقْطَعُوا (yustaqṭaʕū) /jus.taq.tˤa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
